reason: The sachet idea fits me, I forget pills at home and carry stuff in my gym bag. But $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and I can get magnesium at the store for less, so I would keep what I have.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer. I don't see why I pay extra for sachets.
would_change_my_mind: A price around $20 to $22 for the 30 days, or a cheap trial box so I can see if it is worth it.
